# Degree of Comfort

> Family-owned heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical contractor serving Cincinnati, Ohio and the surrounding Tri-State, including Northern Kentucky and Southeast Indiana. Licensed and insured, with upfront, flat-rate pricing. Phone: (513) 586-5107.

## Services

- [Heating](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/heating/): furnace, boiler, and heat pump repair, maintenance, and replacement
- [Boilers](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/boilers/): hot water and steam boiler repair, maintenance, and replacement
- [Air Conditioning](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/air-conditioning/): AC repair, maintenance, and installation
- [Plumbing](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/plumbing/): repairs, water heaters, drains, sewer lines, and emergency plumbing
- [Tankless Water Heaters](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/tankless-water-heater/): installation and service
- [Electrical](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/services/electrical/): panels, wiring, outlets, EV chargers, and lighting
- [Areas We Serve](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/areas/): Cincinnati neighborhoods and nearby communities
- [Comfort Club](https://www.cincydegreeofcomfort.com/comfort-club/): maintenance membership with priority service
